title: Device Architecture Schema
description: Schema for describing device architecture properties and capabilities

Provenance.description: Where a figure came from. 'Published': the vendor states it in a datasheet, spec sheet, whitepaper or ISA document. 'Derived': it is computed from other figures in this file by an arithmetic the surrounding Description states. 'Measured': it was observed on real hardware by a named benchmark. A figure supported by none of the three is not recorded at all.

Throughput.description: One rate figure for ONE unit of the entry that carries it, qualified by the precision and the operating mode it applies to and tagged with its provenance

Precision.description: Numeric format the rate applies to. Omit for rates that are precision-independent, such as a link rate or an instruction issue rate

Mode.description: Operating mode the rate applies to, where one unit has more than one. Vendor-specific by nature, so this is a free string rather than an enum: e.g. 'LoFi', 'HiFi2', 'HiFi4' (Tenstorrent matrix fidelity phases), 'Dense', 'Sparse' (structured sparsity), 'Bidirectional', 'Unidirectional' (links), 'Read', 'Write' (memory ports), 'Fused' (fused instruction issue)

Rate.description: The figure itself, expressed in Unit. Always read back as a double: it is declared _prop_flt in include/knexus-api/_nxs_propertys.h, so a whole-number literal such as 664 reads back as 664.0 and not as an integer

Unit.description: Unit of Rate. A closed vocabulary, so two devices' figures are comparable; a figure whose unit is missing here earns a new enum value rather than a free string

Performance.description: Speeds and feeds of ONE unit of the entry that carries it -- one core, one engine, one link, one instance of that memory. The entry's Count supplies the per-parent multiplier, so chip totals are not restated here. Additive and optional: an entry with no published, derivable or measured figure omits the block rather than guessing one.

ClockRate.description: Clock this unit runs at, in MHz -- and the clock the Throughput figures below are quoted at (e.g. 1350 for Blackhole's 1.35 GHz AI clock, 1980 for an H100 SXM5 boost clock). Always read back as a double: it is declared _prop_flt in include/knexus-api/_nxs_propertys.h, so a whole-number literal such as 1350 reads back as 1350.0 and not as an integer

LaneWidth.description: Width in bits of one SIMD lane of this unit (e.g. 32 for the Blackhole SFPU's '32 lanes of 32 bits wide', 64 for a Hopper FP64 core). The lane count is the entry's Size and is not restated here

TransferRate.description: Signalling rate of this unit's external interface in GT/s -- equivalently Gbps per pin or per lane (e.g. 16 for Blackhole's GDDR6, 5.2 for an MI300X HBM3 stack, 6.4 for LPDDR5 at 6400 MT/s). Multiplied by the bus width in bits and divided by 8 it gives GB/s

Latency.description: Access latency of this unit in clock cycles (e.g. 2 for the 2-cycle load latency of a Blackhole Private RISC-V Data RAM)

Throughput.description: Rate figures for one unit, one entry per precision and operating mode. An array rather than fixed keys because the set of precisions and modes is open-ended: fixed keys cannot express Tenstorrent's LoFi/HiFi2/HiFi4 fidelity phases or NVIDIA's dense/sparse pairs

Name.description: Architecture name (e.g., RDNA 3, Ampere, Ada Lovelace)

ReleaseYear.description: Year the architecture was first released

ProcessNode.description: Manufacturing process node size in nanometers

CoreSubsystem.description: Information about the Chip Compute Hierarchy

Name.description: Vendor-specific name for compute units (e.g., CU, SM, Xe-core)

ChipType.description: Unit type representing the whole chip (a key in UnitTypes)

CoreType.description: Unit type representing a single core (a key in UnitTypes, e.g., NeuronCore-v3, Tensix Core)

UnitTypes.description: Unit types in the compute hierarchy (e.g. chip, CU, SIMD, Tensor Core), keyed by type name

Count.description: Number of these units per parent unit

Size.description: Number of sub-units inside this unit (e.g. threads). Defaults to 1 when absent

items.description: Specify memory type embedded in the Core (Lookup in MemorySubsystem)

Subunits.description: Names of the unit types contained in this unit (each entry is a key in UnitTypes)

items.description: Type name of a contained unit (lookup as a key in UnitTypes)

MemoryTypes.description: Details about the memory level, including cache, scratch memory and register files, keyed by the memory's short name (e.g., L1, L2, Infinity Cache, VGPR, SGPR, LDS) -- an identifier, not a caption: no parenthetical scope gloss, no '/'. Scope belongs in the entry's description

MaxMemoryBandwidth.description: Maximum theoretical memory bandwidth in GB/s

maxBusWidth.description: Maximum memory bus width in bits

Toolchains.description: Kernel toolchains this device supports: the programming models, SDKs, compilers and shading languages a kernel can be written against, each with its supported version

Type.description: Name of the toolchain, programming model or shading language (e.g., CUDA, HIP, Metal, OpenCL, PTX ISA, TT-Metalium)

Present.description: Whether the architecture has dedicated ray tracing hardware

Name.description: Vendor-specific name for the RT units

Count.description: Number of RT units per compute unit

RaysPerSecond.description: Ray throughput in giga-rays per second

Present.description: Whether the architecture has dedicated AI hardware

Name.description: Vendor-specific name for AI units (e.g., Tensor Core, Matrix Engine)

Count.description: Number of AI units per compute unit

fp16TopsPerGPU.description: Maximum FP16 operations per second in teraops

int8TopsPerGPU.description: Maximum INT8 operations per second in teraops

BaseClock.description: Maximum thermal design power in watts

BoostClock.description: Maximum thermal design power in watts

MaxTDP.description: Maximum thermal design power in watts

MaxGpus.description: Maximum number of supported GPUs in a multi-GPU configuration
